subject.title: Design: run lifecycle reliability — bounded liveness, abort⇒release, crash resume, completion drive

question: Should this issue remain the canonical staged run-lifecycle reliability umbrella after Track A, or should maintainers split the remaining Track B-D work into separate canonical issues once the linked PR lands?
rationale: The remaining work chooses lifecycle ownership, liveness policy, durable state shape, Codex-wrapper recovery, and user-visible terminal behavior across stable gateway/session surfaces; automation can verify source gaps but should not choose that product boundary.

options.title: Keep as staged umbrella
options.body: Use this issue to coordinate Track A-D until each linked production report can be closed with landed proof.

options.title: Split after Track A
options.body: After the linked Track A PR lands, create narrower canonical issues for liveness, durability, and completion drive, then close the umbrella as superseded by those items.

options.title: Return to per-bug reports
options.body: Decline the umbrella design and continue fixing the linked production reports independently.

recommendation.title: Keep as staged umbrella
recommendation.body: Use this issue to coordinate Track A-D until each linked production report can be closed with landed proof.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus authored, self-assigned, refined the design, and owns the linked Track A branch.
